simulated_stochastic_rationales.rationale_text: Software MMU table isolation without hardware MPU fails IEC 62304 Clause 5.3.5 segregation for Class C.
Segregation must be hardware-enforced to prevent cascading memory corruption.

Software OS task isolation and static memory checking provide acceptable risk mitigation.
Memory protection design satisfies functional safety objectives under current ISO 14971 risk plan.
